conventions: Money is a string with two decimals and no separators. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; received is the email Date header. flags use the run legend and record only what the documents themselves show: PAID, REFUNDED, POVAR and NOPO need the bank feed or the PO list and are not set here. Nothing in this file is a payment decision. Net plus VAT equals gross, and VAT is 20% of net, on every priced GBP document (checked).
